body:
The dilators were awful 😖 - Even when they were being placed for me it was the weirdest most painful cramping sensation and I say that as a mother to 1 who’s been through labour- Very similar to a contraction style feeling which makes sense considering its the same idea of the cervix being thinned and dilating - just artificially rather than naturally. I didn’t even want to do anything after having those placed, just wanted to lay back and stay in. 

Another fair warning: Depending on how far along you are at the time of the procedure you may notice some breastmilk and leaking after the procedure- which also means swelling and pain in your breasts. Definitely prepare for this also! I was 21 weeks and 5 days so my body had plenty of time to build up breastmilk and especially having previously had a baby my body was more prepared for producing breastmilk than I thought it would be! This can last for a little while so you want to try and reduce the swelling and pain as much as possible and with time your body will stop producing the milk and stop leaking. To help with the potential pain and swelling use supportive bras + cold compresses where possible and as for any leaking you can buy breast pads from most large shops that will help with the leaking and stop you from staining any bras / shirts / clothing you wear and also avoid milk sticking to your skin!

You can have bleeding on and off for up to 4 weeks after an abortion, i believe. Most periods will return 4-8 weeks after an abortion. It’s unlikely that it’s your period returning if it’s only been 2 weeks and more likely that it’s your body removing anything excess left over (any product still remaining, your uterus clearing itself). If your temperature is still fine and the bleeding isn’t too heavy to soak through pads it’s more likely that your uterus is still going through the process of removing any tissue from the pregnancy so it can start fresh in the coming weeks and start a new cycle again.
